summary.value: Choose a Species Forte — never humanoid.

system.description: Choose a Species Forte — never humanoid. Once per scene, create a Bond of admiration or inferiority toward a Forte creature whose presence or signs you are aware of: your Quarry, at +(SL) to track, locate, identify and Study. Absent Quarry: action + 1 Fabula Point learns its direction plus a free remote Study. If no Bond can form, the Species is not present and did not pass through.
